items.title: LRMoE: Memory-Aware MoE Training System
items.summary: LRMoE is a memory-aware Mixture-of-Experts training system that jointly recalibrates backward demand and balances retained workloads on memory-constrained nodes. Experiments show it reduces cumulative training time by 21.2-44.8% relative to SYMI.
keyPoints: Addresses memory bottlenecks caused by expert replication competing with token buffers.
Uses backward demand estimation and physical compaction to reduce execution-buffer demand.
Reduces cumulative MoE-layer training time by 21.2-44.8% on Qwen3-30B-A3B and GLM4.5-106B-A12B.

en.title: LRMoE: Memory-Aware MoE Training System
en.summary: LRMoE is a memory-aware Mixture-of-Experts training system that jointly recalibrates backward demand and balances retained workloads on memory-constrained nodes. Experiments show it reduces cumulative training time by 21.2-44.8% relative to SYMI.
keyPoints: Addresses memory bottlenecks caused by expert replication competing with token buffers.
Uses backward demand estimation and physical compaction to reduce execution-buffer demand.
Reduces cumulative MoE-layer training time by 21.2-44.8% on Qwen3-30B-A3B and GLM4.5-106B-A12B.

fr.title: LRMoE : Système d'entraînement MoE conscient de la mémoire
fr.summary: LRMoE est un système d'entraînement de type Mixture-of-Experts qui recalibre la demande en rétropropagation et équilibre la charge de travail sur les nœuds contraints en mémoire. Les expériences montrent une réduction du temps d'entraînement de 21,2 à 44,8 % par rapport à SYMI.
keyPoints: Traite les goulots d'étranglement liés à la concurrence entre réplicas d'experts et tampons de jetons.
Utilise l'estimation de la demande et le compactage physique pour réduire la mémoire tampon.
Réduit le temps d'entraînement cumulé de 21,2 à 44,8 % sur Qwen3-30B-A3B et GLM4.5-106B-A12B.

items.title: OpenAI Supports Shared Robots.txt for AI Training Preferences
items.summary: OpenAI announces it will honor a shared robots.txt signal to help website operators communicate their AI training preferences to participating providers.
keyPoints: OpenAI will honor a shared robots.txt signal.
Aims to help website operators communicate AI training preferences.
Involves participating AI providers.

en.title: OpenAI Supports Shared Robots.txt for AI Training Preferences
en.summary: OpenAI announces it will honor a shared robots.txt signal to help website operators communicate their AI training preferences to participating providers.
keyPoints: OpenAI will honor a shared robots.txt signal.
Aims to help website operators communicate AI training preferences.
Involves participating AI providers.

fr.title: OpenAI soutient un signal robots.txt partagé pour l'entraînement
fr.summary: OpenAI annonce qu'elle respectera un signal robots.txt partagé afin d'aider les exploitants de sites web à communiquer leurs préférences d'entraînement en IA.
keyPoints: OpenAI honorera un signal robots.txt partagé.
Aide les exploitants de sites web à exprimer leurs préférences d'entraînement.
Concerne les fournisseurs d'IA participants.

items.title: Amortized Localized Posterior Inference for Model Calibration
items.summary: This work constructs a family of localized posteriors using Gaussian localization weights and amortized variational inference to improve model calibration across a context domain, reducing errors in ocean turbulence closure and twin experiments.
keyPoints: Constructs localized posteriors by weighting observation likelihoods by proximity to a target context.
Employs a conditional normalizing flow through amortized variational inference.
Reduces temperature and zonal-velocity errors in ocean model k-epsilon turbulence closure.

en.title: Amortized Localized Posterior Inference for Model Calibration
en.summary: This work constructs a family of localized posteriors using Gaussian localization weights and amortized variational inference to improve model calibration across a context domain, reducing errors in ocean turbulence closure and twin experiments.
keyPoints: Constructs localized posteriors by weighting observation likelihoods by proximity to a target context.
Employs a conditional normalizing flow through amortized variational inference.
Reduces temperature and zonal-velocity errors in ocean model k-epsilon turbulence closure.

fr.title: Inférence a posteriori localisée et amortie pour la calibration
fr.summary: Cette étude construit une famille de lois a posteriori localisées à l'aide de poids gaussiens et d'inférence variationnelle amortie pour améliorer la calibration des modèles, réduisant les erreurs dans la fermeture de la turbulence océanique.
keyPoints: Construit des lois a posteriori localisées en pondérant la vraisemblance selon la proximité contextuelle.
Utilise un flux normalisant conditionnel via l'inférence variationnelle amortie.
Réduit les erreurs de température et de vitesse zonale dans la fermeture de la turbulence k-epsilon.

items.title: OpenAI Highlights Court Briefs on Fair Use Benefits
items.summary: OpenAI shares excerpts from legal briefs by creators, academics, and experts explaining how fair use supports AI training and innovation.
keyPoints: Shares excerpts from court briefs by diverse experts and creators.
Explores how fair use supports AI training.
Highlights benefits to broader innovation.

en.title: OpenAI Highlights Court Briefs on Fair Use Benefits
en.summary: OpenAI shares excerpts from legal briefs by creators, academics, and experts explaining how fair use supports AI training and innovation.
keyPoints: Shares excerpts from court briefs by diverse experts and creators.
Explores how fair use supports AI training.
Highlights benefits to broader innovation.

fr.title: OpenAI met en avant des mémoires judiciaires sur le fair use
fr.summary: OpenAI partage des extraits de mémoires juridiques rédigés par des créateurs, universitaires et experts sur la manière dont le fair use soutient l'entraînement de l'IA et l'innovation.
keyPoints: Partage des extraits de mémoires de divers experts et créateurs.
Examine comment le fair use soutient l'entraînement en IA.
Souligne les avantages pour l'innovation générale.

items.title: ThinkJev: Calibrated Typed Decisions with Hybrid-Thinking Models
items.summary: ThinkJev builds a fast and slow decision system from a single open hybrid-thinking model, using statistical thresholds to route decisions and save thought tokens while maintaining accuracy.
keyPoints: Combines direct answers and thought processes from a single hybrid model.
Uses a statistical test on dev data to guarantee error rates under a target percentage.
Achieves high accuracy on typed decisions while saving a significant amount of thought tokens.

en.title: ThinkJev: Calibrated Typed Decisions with Hybrid-Thinking Models
en.summary: ThinkJev builds a fast and slow decision system from a single open hybrid-thinking model, using statistical thresholds to route decisions and save thought tokens while maintaining accuracy.
keyPoints: Combines direct answers and thought processes from a single hybrid model.
Uses a statistical test on dev data to guarantee error rates under a target percentage.
Achieves high accuracy on typed decisions while saving a significant amount of thought tokens.

fr.title: ThinkJev : Décisions typées calibrées avec des modèles hybrides
fr.summary: ThinkJev construit un système de décision rapide et lent à partir d'un unique modèle de pensée hybride ouvert, utilisant des seuils statistiques pour acheminer les requêtes et économiser des jetons.
keyPoints: Combine des réponses directes et des processus de réflexion issus d'un modèle hybride.
Utilise un test statistique pour garantir des taux d'erreur sous un seuil cible.
Atteint une grande précision sur les décisions typées tout en économisant des jetons de réflexion.

items.title: OpenFrontiers: Benchmark for Scientific Rediscovery in LLMs
items.summary: OpenFrontiers introduces a structured corpus of 12,151 open research problems and a benchmark of 200 mathematical problems to evaluate research-level scientific rediscovery in LLM agents.
keyPoints: Combines a corpus of 12,151 open research problems with a 200-problem benchmark.
Features Lean 4 statements checked by automated probes and independent reviews.
Evaluates seven LLM agents, showing closed-book rediscovery is rare.

en.title: OpenFrontiers: Benchmark for Scientific Rediscovery in LLMs
en.summary: OpenFrontiers introduces a structured corpus of 12,151 open research problems and a benchmark of 200 mathematical problems to evaluate research-level scientific rediscovery in LLM agents.
keyPoints: Combines a corpus of 12,151 open research problems with a 200-problem benchmark.
Features Lean 4 statements checked by automated probes and independent reviews.
Evaluates seven LLM agents, showing closed-book rediscovery is rare.

fr.title: OpenFrontiers : Un benchmark pour la redécouverte scientifique
fr.summary: OpenFrontiers introduit un corpus structuré de 12 151 problèmes de recherche ouverts et un benchmark de 200 problèmes mathématiques pour évaluer la redécouverte scientifique par des agents LLM.
keyPoints: Associe un corpus de 12 151 problèmes ouverts à un benchmark de 200 problèmes.
Intègre des déclarations Lean 4 vérifiées par des sondes automatisées et des révisions.
Évalue sept agents LLM, montrant que la redécouverte en milieu fermé est rare.

items.title: WebAnything: Automated Reconstruction of Web Agent Environments
items.summary: WebAnything is an automated framework that reconstructs source-grounded, reusable website environments from real URLs to train and evaluate web agents without manual implementation.
keyPoints: Reconstructs reusable website environments from real URLs automatically.
Constructs 244 website artifacts across 14 application domains supporting 12,984 tasks.
Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B on interaction trajectories improves task success rates.

en.title: WebAnything: Automated Reconstruction of Web Agent Environments
en.summary: WebAnything is an automated framework that reconstructs source-grounded, reusable website environments from real URLs to train and evaluate web agents without manual implementation.
keyPoints: Reconstructs reusable website environments from real URLs automatically.
Constructs 244 website artifacts across 14 application domains supporting 12,984 tasks.
Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B on interaction trajectories improves task success rates.

fr.title: WebAnything : Reconstruction automatisée d'environnements pour agents web
fr.summary: WebAnything est un cadre automatisé qui reconstitue des environnements de sites web réutilisables à partir d'URL réelles pour entraîner et évaluer des agents web sans implémentation manuelle.
keyPoints: Reconstitue automatiquement des environnements web réutilisables à partir d'URL réelles.
Génère 244 artéfacts de sites web dans 14 domaines d'application prenant en charge 12 984 tâches.
L'affinage de Qwen3.5-9B améliore les taux de réussite des tâches.

items.title: Evaluating Ontology Checkers for LLM Agents over Knowledge Graphs
items.summary: This study evaluates curated, LLM-generated, and data-derived ontologies as checkers for LLM agents querying knowledge graphs, analyzing error detection trade-offs and false alarms.
keyPoints: Compares curated, LLM-generated, and data-derived ontologies used as agent checkers.
Analyzes how each source trades caught errors against false alarms.
Shows curated schemas can contradict underlying data and yield high false flags.

en.title: Evaluating Ontology Checkers for LLM Agents over Knowledge Graphs
en.summary: This study evaluates curated, LLM-generated, and data-derived ontologies as checkers for LLM agents querying knowledge graphs, analyzing error detection trade-offs and false alarms.
keyPoints: Compares curated, LLM-generated, and data-derived ontologies used as agent checkers.
Analyzes how each source trades caught errors against false alarms.
Shows curated schemas can contradict underlying data and yield high false flags.

fr.title: Évaluation de validateurs ontologiques pour agents LLM sur graphes
fr.summary: Cette étude évalue des ontologies conservées, générées par LLM ou dérivées de données comme validateurs pour des agents interrogeant des graphes de connaissances, analysant les compromis de détection d'erreurs.
keyPoints: Compare des ontologies de sources diverses utilisées pour valider les agents.
Analyse le compromis entre erreurs détectées et fausses alarmes pour chaque source.
Montre que les schémas conservés peuvent contredire leurs propres données.

items.title: Measuring Intent Loss in Agentic Smart Contract Synthesis
items.summary: This study evaluates how AI agents lose user intent when synthesizing smart contracts, proposing an elicitation-first architecture that queries clients with a checklist before coding.
keyPoints: Replays transactions to measure discrepancies between AI-written and original smart contracts.
Finds common AI judges and analysis tools miss obvious structural mistakes.
Proposes an elicitation-first architecture to gather requirements before code generation.

en.title: Measuring Intent Loss in Agentic Smart Contract Synthesis
en.summary: This study evaluates how AI agents lose user intent when synthesizing smart contracts, proposing an elicitation-first architecture that queries clients with a checklist before coding.
keyPoints: Replays transactions to measure discrepancies between AI-written and original smart contracts.
Finds common AI judges and analysis tools miss obvious structural mistakes.
Proposes an elicitation-first architecture to gather requirements before code generation.

fr.title: Mesure de la perte d'intention dans la synthèse de contrats intelligents
fr.summary: Cette étude évalue la perte d'intention des agents IA lors de la synthèse de contrats intelligents et propose une architecture axée sur l'élicitation préalable des besoins des clients.
keyPoints: Rejoue des transactions pour mesurer les écarts entre contrats générés et originaux.
Montre que les outils d'analyse standards ratent des erreurs évidentes.
Propose de recueillir les exigences manquantes avant toute génération de code.

items.title: Detecting Covert Collusion in AI Agents via PoPLi
items.summary: Partner-Outsider Positive Listening (PoPLi) is proposed as a behavioral test to detect covert collusion or hidden communication conventions between AI agents by measuring reaction changes to reworded messages.
keyPoints: Introduces PoPLi to detect covert codes in agent communications via message rewording.
Evaluated in a simulated market across five specific conditions.
Demonstrates effectiveness in spotting private communication channels where message-only monitors fail.

en.title: Detecting Covert Collusion in AI Agents via PoPLi
en.summary: Partner-Outsider Positive Listening (PoPLi) is proposed as a behavioral test to detect covert collusion or hidden communication conventions between AI agents by measuring reaction changes to reworded messages.
keyPoints: Introduces PoPLi to detect covert codes in agent communications via message rewording.
Evaluated in a simulated market across five specific conditions.
Demonstrates effectiveness in spotting private communication channels where message-only monitors fail.

fr.title: Détection de collusion cachée entre agents IA via PoPLi
fr.summary: La méthode PoPLi est proposée comme test comportemental pour détecter la collusion cachée ou les conventions de communication secrètes entre agents IA en mesurant les réactions à des messages reformulés.
keyPoints: Introduit PoPLi pour détecter les codes cachés par reformulation des messages.
Évalué dans un marché simulé à travers cinq conditions différentes.
Démontre son efficacité pour repérer les canaux privés là où les moniteurs textuels échouent.

items.title: Evaluating and improving AI agents for sequencing protocols
items.summary: Existing benchmarks rarely test if agents can reconstruct exact molecular structures and generation workflows specified by sequencing protocols. Researchers introduce LibStructBench, showing frontier agents produce approximately correct reconstructions but struggle with exact molecular states and workflow connectivity.
keyPoints: Introduces LibStructBench for sequencing-library structures.
Frontier agents struggle with exact molecular-state representation.
Switching language models produced larger performance shifts than agent harnesses.

en.title: Evaluating and improving AI agents for sequencing protocols
en.summary: Existing benchmarks rarely test if agents can reconstruct exact molecular structures and generation workflows specified by sequencing protocols. Researchers introduce LibStructBench, showing frontier agents produce approximately correct reconstructions but struggle with exact molecular states and workflow connectivity.
keyPoints: Introduces LibStructBench for sequencing-library structures.
Frontier agents struggle with exact molecular-state representation.
Switching language models produced larger performance shifts than agent harnesses.

fr.title: Évaluation et amélioration des agents IA pour le séquençage
fr.summary: Les benchmarks actuels évaluent rarement la reconstruction exacte des structures moléculaires par les agents. Les chercheurs présentent LibStructBench, révélant que les agents de pointe réussissent des reconstructions approximatives mais peinent sur les états moléculaires exacts.
keyPoints: Introduction de LibStructBench pour les structures de bibliothèques.
Les agents de pointe peinent sur la représentation des états moléculaires.
Changer de modèle linguistique a eu plus d'impact que de changer de harnais.

items.title: Seq@K: Evaluating Language Models Under Sequential Feedback
items.summary: Language model agents often refine answers iteratively using feedback, yet models are ranked by Pass@1 or Pass@K metrics that ignore this capability. The authors introduce Seq@K to measure problem-solving within K sequential attempts with feedback, revealing a distinct model-selection landscape.
keyPoints: Introduces Seq@K evaluation protocol for sequential feedback.
Evaluates 16 frontier models across 7 benchmarks.
Shows Seq@K reveals different model rankings and efficiency configurations.

en.title: Seq@K: Evaluating Language Models Under Sequential Feedback
en.summary: Language model agents often refine answers iteratively using feedback, yet models are ranked by Pass@1 or Pass@K metrics that ignore this capability. The authors introduce Seq@K to measure problem-solving within K sequential attempts with feedback, revealing a distinct model-selection landscape.
keyPoints: Introduces Seq@K evaluation protocol for sequential feedback.
Evaluates 16 frontier models across 7 benchmarks.
Shows Seq@K reveals different model rankings and efficiency configurations.

fr.title: Seq@K : Évaluation des modèles linguistiques sous rétroaction
fr.summary: Les agents affinent leurs réponses de manière itérative via des rétroactions, mais sont classés par des métriques ignorant cette capacité. Les auteurs présentent Seq@K pour mesurer la résolution de problèmes en K tentatives avec rétroaction.
keyPoints: Introduction du protocole d'évaluation Seq@K.
Évaluation de 16 modèles de pointe sur 7 benchmarks.
Démontre des classements de modèles différents sous Seq@K.

items.title: Food Similarity and Visual Representations in Indian Cuisine
items.summary: Food similarity drives retrieval and recommendation, but representations are typically evaluated by identity preservation. Using an expanded Khana dataset and seven pretrained visual representations, researchers examine image-to-image retrieval and dish neighborhoods in Indian cuisine.
keyPoints: Evaluates seven pretrained visual representations on Indian cuisine.
Finds image-level neighborhoods vary substantially across representations.
Dish-level visual similarity corresponds less strongly with recipe similarity.

en.title: Food Similarity and Visual Representations in Indian Cuisine
en.summary: Food similarity drives retrieval and recommendation, but representations are typically evaluated by identity preservation. Using an expanded Khana dataset and seven pretrained visual representations, researchers examine image-to-image retrieval and dish neighborhoods in Indian cuisine.
keyPoints: Evaluates seven pretrained visual representations on Indian cuisine.
Finds image-level neighborhoods vary substantially across representations.
Dish-level visual similarity corresponds less strongly with recipe similarity.

fr.title: Similarité alimentaire et représentations visuelles
fr.summary: La similarité alimentaire sous-tend la recherche et la recommandation. À l'aide de l'ensemble Khana et de sept représentations visuelles, les chercheurs examinent la récupération d'images et les voisinages de plats dans la cuisine indienne.
keyPoints: Évaluation de sept représentations visuelles pré-entraînées.
Les voisinages d'images varient considérablement selon les représentations.
La similarité visuelle des plats correspond moins à la similarité des recettes.

items.title: Verification Learning Theory in AI-Assisted Judgment
items.summary: Accurate AI assistance can improve immediate judgments while reducing practice for independent performance. Verification Learning Theory (VLT) formalizes this by linking perceived assistant reliability to evidence checking and retained rule use.
keyPoints: Introduces Verification Learning Theory (VLT) for AI assistance.
Links perceived reliability to evidence checking and retained rule use.
Predicts perceived fallibility can improve delayed unaided judgment.

en.title: Verification Learning Theory in AI-Assisted Judgment
en.summary: Accurate AI assistance can improve immediate judgments while reducing practice for independent performance. Verification Learning Theory (VLT) formalizes this by linking perceived assistant reliability to evidence checking and retained rule use.
keyPoints: Introduces Verification Learning Theory (VLT) for AI assistance.
Links perceived reliability to evidence checking and retained rule use.
Predicts perceived fallibility can improve delayed unaided judgment.

fr.title: Théorie de l'apprentissage par vérification dans le jugement
fr.summary: L'assistance IA précise peut améliorer les jugements immédiats tout en réduisant la pratique indépendante. La théorie de l'apprentissage par vérification (VLT) formalise cela en liant la fiabilité perçue de l'assistant à la vérification des preuves.
keyPoints: Introduction de la théorie de l'apprentissage par vérification (VLT).
Lie la fiabilité perçue à la vérification des preuves et à l'utilisation des règles.
Prévoit que la faillibilité perçue peut améliorer le jugement différé.

items.title: Socio-Demographics and Reasoning in Pluralistic Offensiveness
items.summary: Pluralistic modeling incorporates annotators' socio-demographic information to capture subjective offensiveness judgments. This study analyzes when socio-demographics help and the role of explicit reasoning in leveraging this information.
keyPoints: Demographic gains are small for individuals but clearer at group levels.
Explicit reasoning decomposes judgment into baseline and demographic shifts.
Reasoning yields more accurate predictions than direct conditioning alone.

en.title: Socio-Demographics and Reasoning in Pluralistic Offensiveness
en.summary: Pluralistic modeling incorporates annotators' socio-demographic information to capture subjective offensiveness judgments. This study analyzes when socio-demographics help and the role of explicit reasoning in leveraging this information.
keyPoints: Demographic gains are small for individuals but clearer at group levels.
Explicit reasoning decomposes judgment into baseline and demographic shifts.
Reasoning yields more accurate predictions than direct conditioning alone.

fr.title: Socio-démographie et raisonnement dans la modélisation
fr.summary: La modélisation pluraliste intègre les informations sociodémographiques des annotateurs pour capturer les jugements subjectifs d'offense. Cette étude analyse l'utilité de ces données et le rôle du raisonnement explicite.
keyPoints: Les gains démographiques sont faibles individuellement mais clairs au niveau des groupes.
Le raisonnement explicite décompose le jugement en de multiples composantes.
Le raisonnement donne des prédictions plus précises que le conditionnement direct.

items.title: FilingLoop: LLM Agents for Corporate Disclosure Review
items.summary: Public disclosure reviews require discovering unstated deficiencies and verifying revisions. The authors introduce FilingLoop, an interactive benchmark and self-evolving agent framework for corporate disclosure review grounded in SEC correspondence.
keyPoints: Introduces FilingLoop benchmark based on SEC correspondence.
Framework couples iterative review with procedural learning across cases.
Evolution increases requirement fulfillment from 24.28% to 27.96%.

en.title: FilingLoop: LLM Agents for Corporate Disclosure Review
en.summary: Public disclosure reviews require discovering unstated deficiencies and verifying revisions. The authors introduce FilingLoop, an interactive benchmark and self-evolving agent framework for corporate disclosure review grounded in SEC correspondence.
keyPoints: Introduces FilingLoop benchmark based on SEC correspondence.
Framework couples iterative review with procedural learning across cases.
Evolution increases requirement fulfillment from 24.28% to 27.96%.

fr.title: FilingLoop : Agents LLM pour la révision de divulgations
fr.summary: La révision de divulgations publiques nécessite de découvrir des lacunes. Les auteurs présentent FilingLoop, un benchmark interactif et un cadre d'agent auto-évolutif pour la révision de divulgations d'entreprise basé sur la correspondance SEC.
keyPoints: Introduction du benchmark FilingLoop basé sur la correspondance SEC.
Associe révision itérative et apprentissage procédural.
L'évolution augmente la satisfaction des exigences de 24,28 % à 27,96 %.

items.title: Frequency-Selective Spiking Reservoirs with Resonant Neurons
items.summary: Spiking reservoir computing offers energy-efficient inference, but existing reservoirs rely on leaky integrate-and-fire neurons whose low-pass dynamics limit temporal frequency handling. The authors introduce HRF-Res using Harmonic Resonate-and-Fire neurons.
keyPoints: Introduces HRF-Res replacing LIF neurons with Harmonic Resonate-and-Fire neurons.
Enables selective response to input frequencies for temporal patterns.
Achieves up to 19x lower energy consumption than non-spiking oscillatory reservoirs.

en.title: Frequency-Selective Spiking Reservoirs with Resonant Neurons
en.summary: Spiking reservoir computing offers energy-efficient inference, but existing reservoirs rely on leaky integrate-and-fire neurons whose low-pass dynamics limit temporal frequency handling. The authors introduce HRF-Res using Harmonic Resonate-and-Fire neurons.
keyPoints: Introduces HRF-Res replacing LIF neurons with Harmonic Resonate-and-Fire neurons.
Enables selective response to input frequencies for temporal patterns.
Achieves up to 19x lower energy consumption than non-spiking oscillatory reservoirs.

fr.title: Réservoirs à impulsions sélectifs en fréquence
fr.summary: Le calcul par réservoir à impulsions offre une inférence économe en énergie, mais les réservoirs existants dépendent de neurones aux dynamiques passe-bas. Les auteurs présentent HRF-Res utilisant des neurones harmoniques résonnants.
keyPoints: Introduction de HRF-Res avec des neurones Harmoniques Résonnants.
Permet une réponse sélective aux fréquences d'entrée pour les motifs temporels.
Atterrit jusqu'à 19 fois moins de consommation d'énergie.

items.title: SciGame: Evaluating Scientific Discovery Agents
items.summary: Large language model agents are increasingly used for scientific discovery, but existing benchmarks mix law inference with programming. The authors introduce SciGame, a controlled benchmark converting scientific literature into structured scientific cards.
keyPoints: Introduces SciGame benchmark with original and counterfactual environments.
Contains historical collections and live temporal collections past cutoffs.
Shows familiar priors hurt performance when governing relations change.

en.title: SciGame: Evaluating Scientific Discovery Agents
en.summary: Large language model agents are increasingly used for scientific discovery, but existing benchmarks mix law inference with programming. The authors introduce SciGame, a controlled benchmark converting scientific literature into structured scientific cards.
keyPoints: Introduces SciGame benchmark with original and counterfactual environments.
Contains historical collections and live temporal collections past cutoffs.
Shows familiar priors hurt performance when governing relations change.

fr.title: SciGame : Évaluation des agents de découverte scientifique
fr.summary: Les agents LLM sont de plus en plus utilisés pour la découverte scientifique, mais les benchmarks actuels mélangent l'inférence de lois et la programmation. Les auteurs présentent SciGame, un benchmark contrôlé convertissant la littérature en cartes.
keyPoints: Introduction du benchmark SciGame avec environnements originaux et contrefactuels.
Contient des collections historiques et temporelles.
Montre que les a priori familiers nuisent lorsque les relations changent.

items.title: VerifiedLab: Multi-Agent Framework for Knowledge Transition
items.summary: As research agents deploy for laboratory experiments, knowledge transitions from human-written records to machine-readable systems. The authors introduce VerifiedLab, a multi-agent framework to verify and disseminate research output.
keyPoints: Introduces VerifiedLab multi-agent harness framework for knowledge transition.
AI scientists verify records field by field with roles like PI and librarian.
Demonstrated on perovskite solar cells to recover trends and anticipate devices.

en.title: VerifiedLab: Multi-Agent Framework for Knowledge Transition
en.summary: As research agents deploy for laboratory experiments, knowledge transitions from human-written records to machine-readable systems. The authors introduce VerifiedLab, a multi-agent framework to verify and disseminate research output.
keyPoints: Introduces VerifiedLab multi-agent harness framework for knowledge transition.
AI scientists verify records field by field with roles like PI and librarian.
Demonstrated on perovskite solar cells to recover trends and anticipate devices.

fr.title: VerifiedLab : Cadre multi-agent pour la transition des connaissances
fr.summary: À mesure que les agents de recherche se déployent, les connaissances passent de documents humains à des systèmes lisibles par machine. Les auteurs présentent VerifiedLab, un cadre multi-agent pour vérifier et diffuser les extrants de recherche.
keyPoints: Introduction du cadre multi-agent VerifiedLab pour la transition des connaissances.
Des scientifiques IA vérifient les dossiers champ par champ.
Démontré sur des cellules solaires à pérovskite pour anticiper les dispositifs.

items.title: GARDEN: Autonomous Reward Design for Cooperative MARL
items.summary: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning relies heavily on manually designed reward functions. The authors propose GARDEN, where a single reward program is developed for a family of scenarios and transferred to unseen scenarios.
keyPoints: Proposes GARDEN for generalist autonomous reward design in MARL.
Developed via LLM reward engineers investigating environment code and trials.
Increased task returns by 58.2% and 52.5% on Overcooked and SMAX benchmarks.

en.title: GARDEN: Autonomous Reward Design for Cooperative MARL
en.summary: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning relies heavily on manually designed reward functions. The authors propose GARDEN, where a single reward program is developed for a family of scenarios and transferred to unseen scenarios.
keyPoints: Proposes GARDEN for generalist autonomous reward design in MARL.
Developed via LLM reward engineers investigating environment code and trials.
Increased task returns by 58.2% and 52.5% on Overcooked and SMAX benchmarks.

fr.title: GARDEN : Conception de récompenses autonomes pour l'apprentissage
fr.summary: L'apprentissage par renforcement multi-agent coopératif dépend de fonctions de récompense conçues manuellement. Les auteurs proposent GARDEN, où un seul programme de récompense est développé pour une famille de scénarios.
keyPoints: Propose GARDEN pour la conception autonome de récompenses dans l'apprentissage multi-agent.
Développé via des ingénieurs de récompense LLM analysant le code et les essais.
A augmenté les retours de tâches de 58,2 % et 52,5 % sur les benchmarks Overcooked et SMAX.
